title: Smoke Retention Policy — 5 条规则治理测试膨胀
description:
EPIC-174 — 借鉴 loopx AGENTS.md Smoke Retention Policy: 5 条规则治理测试膨胀.

**Context**: 主公 2026-08-05 Phase 5 D 拍板. loopx AGENTS.md 规定 5 条 smoke retention 规则:
1. 保留 shipped CLI/runtime behavior
2. 保留 reusable control-plane contract
3. 保留 public/private boundary enforcement
4. 保留 regression that stranded automation
5. 5xx 行 smoke 拆 / aggregate 替代

**设计**:
1. **docs/process/smoke-retention-policy.md** — 5 条规则详化 (跟 loopx 1:1)
2. **scripts/check-smoke-retention.sh** — scanner 检测 5xx 行 smoke + suggest 拆
3. **scripts/audit/smoke-size-report.sh** — 报告 5xx 行 smoke
4. **rename / 整合** — 当前 tests/integration 超过 5xx 行的 smoke 列出 (跟 loopx 1:1 'Pre-existing CI debt' 处理)
5. **CLAUDE.md / docs/PROCESS.md** 引用 smoke retention policy

**0 增 Rule, 0 改 source code** (仅 docs + scripts + 测试重组)
acceptance: AC1: docs/process/smoke-retention-policy.md ≥80 行 含 5 条规则详化 (跟 loopx 1:1)
AC2: scripts/check-smoke-retention.sh 检测 ≥5xx 行 smoke + 输出告警
AC3: scripts/audit/smoke-size-report.sh 列当前所有 smoke 状态 (行数 + 价值判定)
AC4: docs/PROCESS.md 加 smoke retention 段 + 引用
AC5: CLAUDE.md Section 5 加 smoke retention policy 引用
AC9: 0 改 source code, 0 增 Rule, 0 增 immutable script
deliverables: docs/PROCESS.md 改 (加 smoke retention 段)
CLAUDE.md 改 (Section 5 加 smoke retention 引用)
